_comment: Ratchet ceiling per locale, from catalogue-audit.ts. A locale's issue count must never exceed its number here -- see catalogue-audit.test.ts. Lower a number (and commit) as a translation batch actually fixes issues; raise one only when Phase 3 adds new keys to en.ts, which every untranslated locale is then 'missing' until its own batch lands. Never raise a number to make a red test pass. Batch raised 2026-09-23 (MegaMenuNav, ~132 keys): merged with an English fallback in every locale, read as untranslated ('wrong-script') until a real translation lands -- this debt is still outstanding for all 21 locales (accounts for the ~264 floor most locales sit at). Batch raised 2026-09-23 (MoSJE tier 4, 257 keys): real translations landed for 18 of 21 locales same day; brx/ks/sd got English-fallback text. Batch fixed 2026-09-24: real (machine-assisted) translations for brx (Bodo, Devanagari), ks (Kashmiri, Perso-Arabic) and sd (Sindhi, Perso-Arabic) landed for all 254 outstanding MoSJE tier-4 keys, lowering their three numbers back to the same MegaMenuNav-only floor every other locale carries. These three are machine translations for low-resource languages and should get a native-speaker review pass before being treated as publish-quality; that review is not a blocker for this ratchet.
